title: 서울역 버스 임시우회 안내 배치: 22개 출발점 비교
status: conditional mapped-network analysis; not observed event-day walking or deployment advice
crs_note: OSM geographic coordinates use WGS84. City page says WGS84 but also EPSG-5179; retain that metadata conflict and treat its interpretation as provisional. City coordinates are used only for locating the old-stop proxy, not to certify a datum transformation.

alternative.label: CPBC 건물 앞 지도상 대체지점
alternative.method: project building centroid onto nearest eligible street-level mapped line, excluding access-controlled ways, steps and corridors as anchor targets
alternative.sensitivity_rule: shift the building-centroid target north/south by 20 projected metres, then apply the same nearest street-level projection; deterministic scenarios, not confidence bounds

anchor_rule: street-level proxy anchors may not land on steps or indoor corridors; select by geometric distance, never by component connectivity or desired result
candidate_rule: origin-to-S mapped shortest-path nodes at junctions (degree>=3) and origin anchors; exclude S and all locations whose only incident ways are steps/corridors
notice_model: Retain the original-stop notice; choose zero, one or two additional notices on fixed mapped shortest approach paths. Read and follow the first encountered notice.
objective: lexicographic minimum of maximum excess mapped length, total excess mapped length, candidate ID
units: metres between projected mapped anchors; real entrance/kerb connectors, waiting, time, fares and personal demand excluded
origin_rule: All subway entrance nodes within 500m of the original stop in the archived network, selected without a connectivity filter.
passenger_platform_rule: Include open bus=yes public_transport=platform highway=platform lines with shared nodes; preserve access, foot, area and directional restrictions; exclude closed outlines.
